name: Choline
aliases: (2-hydroxyethyl)trimethylazanium, (beta-hydroxyethyl)trimethylammonium, 2-hydroxyethyl-trimethyl-ammonium, 2-hydroxyethyl-trimethyl-azanium, choline cation, choline ion, N-trimethylethanolamine, N,N,N-trimethylethanol-ammonium
summary: Choline is a cation with the chemical formula [(CH3)3NCH2CH2OH]+. Choline forms various salts, such as choline chloride and choline bitartrate. An essential nutrient for animals, it is a structural component of phospholipids and cell membranes.

pharmacology.text: Choline is used to synthesize acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter involved in muscle control and numerous functions of the nervous system.

uses.text: Choline chloride and choline bitartrate are used in dietary supplements. Bitartrate is used more often due to its lower hygroscopicity. Certain choline salts are used to supplement chicken, turkey, and some other animal feeds. Some salts are also used as industrial chemicals: for example, in photolithography to remove photoresist.

summaryZh: 膽鹼（英語：Choline），是一種構成細胞膜磷脂質的重要營養素，也是人體合成甘胺酸的原料之一，廣泛存在於各種食物中。1864年由 Andreas Strecker 從豬膽汁中首先分離出來，1866年被化學合成。體內的膽鹼有很大一部分來源於食物。它在大腸中被分解為三甲胺。

sideEffects.en: Large amounts can cause a fishy body odour, stomach upset, diarrhoea, sweating and low blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 大量攝取可能造成身體散發魚腥味、腸胃不適、腹瀉、出汗與血壓降低。
sideEffects.zhHans: 大量摄取可能造成身体散发鱼腥味、肠胃不适、腹泻、出汗与血压降低。

fact.en: Choline was first isolated in 1862 by the German chemist Adolph Strecker from pig bile, and its name comes from the Greek word for bile, chole.
fact.zh: 膽鹼在 1862 年由德國化學家阿道夫·施特雷克從豬膽汁中首次分離，名稱來自希臘文的膽汁「chole」。
fact.zhHans: 胆碱在 1862 年由德国化学家阿道夫·施特雷克从猪胆汁中首次分离，名称来自希腊文的胆汁「chole」。
